answer: Mining slots require a per-identity stake bond locked from that address, so a farm of forged identities must fund every bond separately and each lock is visible on chain, like tents on a terrace where anyone can count them and trace the one wallet paying. Proof of duplicate control slashes the bond and pays it to honest miners, making fraud a donation. An attacker building N ghosts pays N bonds plus N funding transactions, and loses all of it when flagged, while a real operator mines like a falcon: one clean identity, full speed. The canyon between honest and forged cost is the point.
